Working definition; distances express the selected representation, not an independently established causal metric.
Feasibility is explicitly conditional on material, procedure, skill range and environment; successful production requires a declared operational criterion.
A lossy representation and a reconstructed record need not be subsets of historical production. Conditional production witnesses feasibility only under its actual conditions.
Notation divides observation from historical explanation. Neither probability distribution is fitted in this study.
Predicting a geometry-assigned label may reproduce the label rule. Independent use evidence is proposed, not claimed to be available in this corpus.

Read the corpus description and archaeological evaluation: ROCOPOT uses published fragment profiles, restricts the matching analysis to rims, and includes archaeological inspection. No complete-vessel feasibility claim is attributed.
The inspected description discusses preprocessing publication profiles and excluding one-of-a-kind profiles; consequences for prevalence are our interpretation.
Read author-hosted PDF. D2 is a distribution of distances between random surface points. Our quantiles sample supplied points, not an area-uniform surface reconstruction.
Read PMLR abstract and bibliographic record. The statement concerns unsupervised disentanglement absent inductive biases; the manuscript does not extend the theorem to all geometric explanation.
Read the primary PMC article sections. Potters reproduce target forms; intermediate shape trajectories support restricted individual/community comparisons, not an exhaustive feasible frontier.
Inspected source metadata/preprocessing and downloaded every selected data blob with Git SHA-1 and SHA-256 checks. The linked journal article's performance claims are not used.

Exact-array duplicate check found none; filename source groups are not evidence of archaeological independence. Split group IDs remain in output/splits.json.
64 D2-style quantiles are a chosen descriptor; acquisition density remains part of the measure. The design and study.py specify 8192 sampled pairs.
Observed normalization uses only observed geometry; the complete-radius oracle is an explicit diagnostic and never an available fragment predictor.

Three fixed group/category-balanced 60/20/20 splits yield 549/184/184 records, independently checked against output/splits.json. All fitting uses training records; labels balance splits but are not prediction targets.
Prespecified uniform and half-space recording masks; these are sensitivity treatments, not calibrated archaeological fracture or scan-error distributions.
Local overlap, global distance rank and archive-label dispersion answer distinct questions; no category label is interpreted as a social population.
Protocol amendments disclose that descriptor resampling and unwhitened PCA/compression controls followed the initial run; original whitened results and prior execution receipts are retained.

All three raw-coordinate descriptor half-clipping rows preserve 33.7-39.8% of neighbours (rounded). Greater stability can preserve size rather than relative shape; superiority for historical recovery is not inferred.

The two explicitly constructed profiles agree exactly for z >= 0.6; synthetic/observed_max_difference is zero and covered by a unit test. Missing-body preference therefore requires a prior or external evidence. No manufacturability or usable-capacity claim.
Proposed inference practice: retain alternatives compatible with external evidence and qualify conclusions that depend on imputation.
Proposed future experiment including attempts, conditions and outcomes, not a claim that the present point-cloud study observed production.
Geometric residuals cannot identify culture without discriminating observations. Material access and documentation examples are hypothetical rival predictions.
Evaluation grouping should follow the intended unit of historical generalization, rather than treating views or reconstructions as independent.
Technical design is recorded in study.py, locked dependencies and protocol: descriptor sampling, network and normalization choices are not empirically calibrated optima.
Fixed 0/25/50/75% loss and 0/0.25/1% bounding-box noise, with seeds 17/29/43; full-reference diagonal sets treatment magnitude only.
1000 object-row bootstrap samples against a fixed gallery; dependent pair distances are not treated as independent observations. Conditional intervals do not quantify cross-population uncertainty.
